entities.text: Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is seen from the very order impugned in the Writ Petition dated 19.04.2012 that the land owners have not accepted the compensation determined by the Collector.

It is therefore clear that the compensation was not determined after private negotiations, the determination made by the Collector was imposed upon the land owners and their signatures were obtained in printed form.
Even there, the land owners have made a specific endorsement that they are signing it without prejudice to their right to claim enhancement.
4. The other contention that is sought to be raised is on the time limit.
Even on the date when the compensation was paid, the land owners made it clear that they are accepting it without prejudice to their right to seek enhancement.
Therefore, that by itself would amount to a https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Review Petition No.200 of 2022 demand for a reference.
Hence the contention based on the time limit is also unfounded.
5. Hence we see no reason to review the orders passed by the Division Bench, the Revision Petition is therefore dismissed.
No costs.
